name: Buybutler
description: Remember which groceries to buy again and which not, with a reason, 1 to 5 stars, the store, the date, a photo and optionally the price paid. Scan the barcode with the phone camera; product names and pictures come from Open Food Facts. Every entry keeps the time it was made and last changed. After the first start, create a user in the container's console: buybutler user add NAME. The camera in the browser needs HTTPS: open it through a reverse proxy with a certificate. The appdata folder holds the database and all photos; back it up.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Database, pictures and backups. Never delete it.

ports.name: Web interface
ports.description: Port of the web interface. Point the reverse proxy here.

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: 002: new files are writable for the users group

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Time zone: decides the date a rating gets by default, and the log

variables.name: Product language
variables.description: Language of product names from Open Food Facts (two letters)

variables.name: Currency
variables.description: Currency of all prices, a three-letter code such as EUR or CHF

variables.name: Public URL
variables.description: The address Buybutler is opened at, such as https://buybutler.example.com; needed for passkeys

variables.name: Open Food Facts lookup
variables.description: false: never send barcodes to Open Food Facts; products are entered by hand

variables.name: Session days
variables.description: Days a login stays valid without being used

variables.name: Trusted proxies
variables.description: Addresses whose X-Forwarded headers are trusted; the reverse proxy's address, or *
